  • We do not disclose HealthKit data to third parties.

Refresher permanently stores heart rate metrics (minimum, maximum, average, samples, and timeline data) on your device using SwiftData, synced to iCloud if enabled. Heart rate data is never sent to our analytics servers or any third party.
